facts.fact: 她惊醒，被遗忘的记忆如洪流回灌，意识到这一切都是她自己造成的
facts.anchor: all my forgotten memories crashing back in a relentless torrent

facts.fact: 她向 Rabb 坦白：General 指控她做过的一切都属实，她如今完全确定了
facts.anchor: It was true. Everything the General said I did. I know it now. For sure.

facts.fact: 从崩塌森林活下来的 General 找到她的钟楼实验室，抢先扑向控制台扳下机器开关
facts.anchor: Before I could stop him, the General leapt toward the control panels to flick the switch on

facts.fact: General 掏出手枪，那是 Wünder 没有的武器，是他当年穿越时从原来的世界带来的
facts.anchor: Wünder didn’t have weapons like this. The General must have brought it with him from our world when we crossed over

facts.fact: Allie 拍下控制台按钮，把 General 冻进惰性泡泡，出膛的子弹悬停在半空
facts.anchor: right in time to freeze the General in an inert bubble

facts.fact: 她决定自己走进机器回到原来的世界，并让机器在她走后过载自毁，使别人再也无法使用这项技术
facts.anchor: I’m setting it to overload after I go. That way, nobody else can use this technology. It’s the only way your world will be safe.

facts.fact: 国王握紧捡到的护身符，一头扎进正在消退的漩涡尾流，追随 Allie 而去
facts.anchor: The king’s grip tightened around the talisman in his hand before he dove headfirst into the fading wake of the maelstrom

facts.fact: Chez 向镜中的 Duchess 报告：Allie 回家了，而 Rabb 追了过去
